name: HALDANE GT3

specs.notes: An original, fictional GT race car (the model is a generic design, no real make); its numbers a plausible GT3 balance-of-performance spec for the APEX GT CHALLENGE, set so it laps CINDER RIDGE within a few tenths of the AFFALTER GT3 on the AI's racing line (tests/race_ai_check.gd). Front-engined: a twin-turbo V8 behind the front axle, a rear transaxle (~48 % front), as the long-nosed GT3s are. The model: 5,030 x 2,130 mm (over the mirrors 2,270), a 2,750 mm wheelbase at its own size.

garage.blurb: A front-engined GT3 with a twin-turbo V8 under a long bonnet: stable on the brakes, a wall of torque out of slow corners, and it pushes a little if you rush the turn-in.

interior.notes: The model has no cabin (tinted glass over nothing): the shared race interior, as the other cars without one.

limitations: A low-poly model (~3,100 body triangles, flat colours, no textures, no cabin): made for a varied AI grid; plainer up close than the scanned GT3 cars.
